title: Husky Dog Tags for Escape Artists | Salty Dog Tags
description: Funny engraved husky dog tags for escape artists, screamers and shedders. Laser engraved in Lehi, Utah. Name and number on the back. From $12.
blurb: Engraved tags for the escape artist that screams at you for being two minutes late with dinner. Huskies talk back. Our bulldogs just sigh. Both are opinions.

hero.alt: Close-up of a laser-engraved dog tag: polished stainless bone with a paw cut-out, engraved WHISKY and a phone number
hero.figcaption: Whisky's actual tag. He's a bulldog, but the laser doesn't care what breed you are.

tough.h2: Built for the dog that already has a getaway plan
tough.html:
If any breed is going to test the back of its tag, it's a husky. They dig under fences, slip collars, and treat a closed gate as a puzzle with a time limit. The tag is the only thing standing between a stranger and a very loud mystery.

That's why the text has to stay readable. Ours is laser-cut into the metal, with no paint on top to chip, so the phone number survives digging, snow, mud and whatever creek they found on the way out of the neighborhood.

If found, the tag does the talking. The husky will also do the talking.

How engraving holds up →

more.h2: Made by a house with seven bulldogs
more.lead: We're a family in Lehi, Utah with seven English bulldogs and one very busy laser. We wrote the bulldog tags first, from experience. The husky lines come from friends who own them, mostly shouted to us over the sound of their husky.

What to Put on a Dog Tag

items.q: Will snow, mud and digging wear off the engraving?
items.a: No. The text is laser engraved into the metal, not printed on top, so there's nothing to scrape or wash off.

items.q: Can I put my husky's name and my phone number on the tag?
items.a: Yes, that's the standard build: saying on the front, your dog's name and your phone number on the back. For an escape artist, put the number first and make it big.

items.q: Do you have sayings written specifically for huskies?
items.a: Eight on this page, about the escapes, the screaming and the shedding. Each fits the tag as written. The full sayings list has hundreds more.

items.q: What happens if the engraving comes out wrong?
items.a: Custom tags aren't returnable, but if we mis-engrave it, we remake it free. Tags are engraved and shipped from Lehi, Utah in 1 to 2 business days, then USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. US only.
